name: Céline Imart - Après le considérant 6 - Am 29
title: REPORT on the proposal for a decision of the European Parliament and of the Council on providing macro-financial assistance to the Arab Republic of Egypt
part_text: (6a) Until safe return, the Union should call on Egypt to ensure official recognition and legal status of Palestinian refugees, guaranteeing them access to essential services, in particular the enrolment of their children in public schools.
